trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it — it is the finish line of the whole route, so plan the run around the other 54 and let this one arrive last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops. [3]
Check the Progress tab here: when it reads 54/55, the one trophy left is the only thing standing between you and the platinum. [4]
Finish A Long Road (100% completion) last if you can — it is the usual final trophy before the platinum. [1]

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Gone Fishing is the first story mission of Chapter 1, so this trophy is unmissable — play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to its end. [1]
Follow the on-screen objectives; the mission teaches movement, driving and the basic controls. [2]
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen — no side objective is needed. [3]

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. This is story progress, so it cannot be missed — keep playing the gold story markers until the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions in order. [1]
Before the chapter ends, meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot — it is gone for good once the chapter closes. [1]
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 1 mission ends and the chapter-complete card shows. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. From this chapter Jason and Lucia are both playable, which opens most of the map's side content — but the trophy itself only needs the story missions done.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions in order. [1]
Use the new freedom of Chapter 2 to meditate at any spot you pass and scan vehicles and animals as you travel. [1]
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 2 mission ends. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Heist trophies start opening up in Chapters 3–4, so keep an eye on optional missions when they appear — but this trophy only needs the chapter finished.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions in order. [1]
Do optional missions the moment they appear; some close off as the story moves on. [1]
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 3 mission ends. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Once this chapter is done, only the final mission stands between you and the story's end — and free roam stays open afterwards for everything else.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions in order. [1]
Make a manual save before the final mission of the chapter, since there is no mission replay. [1]
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 4 mission ends. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the gold story trophy and the gate to free roam cleanup — after the credits, the whole map stays open, so nothing else is locked behind it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish Chapters 1–4, then start the final mission from its story marker. [1]
Make a manual save right before the final mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game+. [1]
The gold trophy pops at the end of the final mission; free roam remains open afterwards for cleanup. [5]

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions are part of the main path, so this trophy comes naturally while playing the story — just do not skip the mission when it appears.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Follow the story until the Breakfast Run mission marker appears. [1]
Play the mission through its objectives to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [3]

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission on the main path — it pops when the job is done, so play the story and take the mission when it shows up.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Follow the story until The Cartel Heist mission marker appears. [1]
Play the heist through its objectives to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [3]

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another named mission on the main story path — unmissable as long as you play the story through.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Follow the story until the Child's Play mission marker appears. [1]
Play the mission through its objectives to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [3]

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story-path mission — it unlocks by playing the story, with nothing extra to prepare.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Follow the story until the Headliners mission marker appears. [1]
Play the mission through its objectives to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [3]

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. A story mission, so it comes from playing the main path — the airport setting is also where the unscheduled-departure trophy later happens.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Follow the story until the VCIA Takedown mission marker appears. [1]
Play the mission through its objectives to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [3]

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies — finish the mission and it pops with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Follow the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission marker appears. [1]
Play the mission through its objectives to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [3]

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion). The bar is forgiving — roughly 60% true completion counts as 100% on the checklist — but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests must be fully done. Check the checklist only after the story, and treat this as the last-but-one trophy.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story to see the checklist — it only appears once the story is done. [1]
Clear the must-complete sets in full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. [1]
Fill the rest toward 100% — vehicles, animals, weapons and challenges count only in part, so skip the hardest ones. [5]

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like — anywhere in Leonida. Stunts count cumulatively, so they pile up naturally while driving hard; the checklist wants 300, so the trophy lands before the 100% bar does.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Drive fast, jump ramps and catch air — every stunt adds to the running total. [1]
Watch the counter here (0/250) and in the game stats; it is cumulative across the whole playthrough. [4]
The silver pops at stunt 250; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist. [1]

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each — one go at each is enough, no win or gold needed. Open the activities list in the game and tick them off one by one; this tracker counts them for you.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Open the activities list and note the 9 types — racing, shooting range, fishing, bowling, arcade, drone racing and the rest. [1]
Try each type once; finishing is not required, just taking part. [5]
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried. [2]

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the pure-skill trophy of the set — take each range challenge one at a time, learn its target pattern, and use a steady weapon. The ranges are also a must-complete set for 100%, so golding them does double duty.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list — 42 challenges across the ranges. [1]
Play each challenge until the gold-medal score; retrying is free and unlimited. [5]
The silver pops when the 42nd challenge turns gold. [1]

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race — win one at each and the trophy pops. Drone races are also a must-complete set for 100%, so do not leave any location unwon.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Find a Top Fun drone-race location and enter its race. [1]
Win the race — learn the course line on the first run, then push for the win. [5]
Repeat at all 14 locations; the trophy pops on the 14th win. [1]

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once — so spread across the map and take a new race each time instead of replaying one you already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Enter a race you have not won before — street, off-road or any type on offer. [1]
Win it; the counter here tracks 0/20 different races won. [4]
Repeat with new races until 20 different wins. [2]

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the side activities — find Cal, take his challenge, and out-fish him. It is also part of the side-story cleanup, so do it while finishing the stranger strands.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge. [1]
Fish the challenge through — steady reeling beats fast reeling when the line is tense. [6]
Beat Cal's catch and the trophy pops at the challenge result. [2]

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest cabinet you find, learn its loop, and play it to completion — one finished game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Enter an arcade and pick a game cabinet. [1]
Play the game through to its end screen. [2]
The trophy pops when the game completes. [3]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Side-story contacts each have a chain of missions — follow Andy's chain whenever his marker appears, and his last mission closes the strand.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Meet Andy and play his missions as they appear. [1]
Keep taking Andy's missions through the strand until his final one unlocks. [5]
Complete Andy's final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand and complete his final mission. Same pattern as the other contacts — play his chain through, and the last mission is the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Meet Kenton and play his missions as they appear. [1]
Keep taking Kenton's missions through the strand until his final one unlocks. [5]
Complete Kenton's final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Follow Billy's chain to its end — the final mission is the trophy, and the strand counts toward the wider side-story cleanup.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Meet Billy and play his missions as they appear. [1]
Keep taking Billy's missions through the strand until his final one unlocks. [5]
Complete Billy's final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [2]

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger strands are time-sensitive — one strand, the race against Yago, closes in Chapter 3 — so start every stranger marker the moment it appears and finish each strand before moving the story on.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Take every stranger marker the moment it appears on the map — do not leave them for later. [1]
Finish the Chapter 3 race against Yago before that story beat passes; it is the strand that can close. [1]
Complete 8 full strands; the silver pops on the eighth. [5]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Play Randy's chain whenever his marker shows, through to his last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Meet Randy and play his missions as they appear. [1]
Keep taking Randy's missions through the strand until his final one unlocks. [5]
Complete Randy's final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand and complete his final mission. Follow Tyrone's chain to its end like the other contacts.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Meet Tyrone and play his missions as they appear. [1]
Keep taking Tyrone's missions through the strand until his final one unlocks. [5]
Complete Tyrone's final mission; the trophy pops at its end. [2]

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

a.text: PowerPyx counts 18 meditation spots, and says one early spot in Chapter 1 is lost for good once that chapter ends.

b.text: OutputLag and eGamers describe the early spot as Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1, and some lists count 15 spots rather than 18.

dispute.note: The two versions disagree on the count (18 vs 15) and on where the Chapter 1 spot is. This guide shows both and plays safe: meditate at every spot the moment you see it, and never skip the Chapter 1 spot.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots by the most complete count. This is the one possibly missable trophy: one spot in Chapter 1 disappears permanently once that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay. Meditate at every spot the moment it appears, and make a manual save at the start of each chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot before that chapter ends — PowerPyx places it at Jason's house. [1]
OutputLag and eGamers describe the same early spot as Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 — treat either description as the same warning: do the early one now. [2]
Keep meditating at every spot you find across Leonida until the counter reads 18/18. [1]

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are a must-complete set for 100%, so take his hunts seriously — track the animal, take the shot, and bring it back. Do his quests as they come rather than leaving them for cleanup.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Take Bret's hunt when his marker appears. [1]
Track the unique animal — its trail and signs lead to it. [5]
Take the animal down and complete the hunt for Bret. [2]

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you travel and keep sets together; the trophy pops when the third set is complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them across Leonida. [1]
Track sets here (0/3) — a set completes when every card in it is found. [4]
The silver pops when the third set is complete. [2]

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state — use the phone feature at each spot you pass, and sweep region by region in free roam until the counter hits 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Open WAiNK at a location and use the WAiNK It action. [1]
Repeat at new locations — the counter here tracks 0/100. [4]
The silver pops at the 100th location. [2]

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals layered over everything else — stunts, shooting, driving — so they fill up while you play. The 100% checklist only needs 70 of 80, so the trophy's 50 arrives well before the end.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Play normally and let challenges complete as you go — driving, shooting and stunts all feed them. [1]
Check the counter here (0/50) against the in-game challenge list. [4]
The trophy pops at the 50th completed challenge. [2]

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Do it in free roam with a fast car and a plan for the escape — break line of sight, then stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Bring your partner along, then raise heat until the wanted level hits 4 stars. [1]
Break line of sight and leave the search area — a fast car and back streets help. [6]
Stay clear until all stars fade; the trophy pops when the heat is fully gone. [2]

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, without losing the wanted level between them — the trick is the opposite of the usual escape: keep the heat, keep moving, and hit the next shop before the stars drop. Plan a route of three close shops first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Pick three shops close together and bring your partner. [1]
Rob the first shop, then drive straight to the next — do not lose the wanted level in between. [6]
Rob the third shop with the heat still on; the trophy pops after the third robbery. [2]

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles across Leonida. Scanning vehicles as you pass them counts toward both this trophy and the 100% checklist — scan early and often, and the trophy lands long before the checklist's 200 of 277.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Scan every new vehicle you pass — the discovery counter is cumulative. [1]
Track progress here (0/100) while you travel between missions. [4]
The trophy pops at the 100th discovered vehicle. [2]

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up: gather a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the focus ends — a crowded firefight is the right moment, not a one-on-one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together. [1]
Trigger Combat Focus once the group is in range. [6]
Down 5 enemies before the focus ends; the trophy pops on the fifth. [2]

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way no timetable planned. Grab an aircraft on the airfield and get airborne without going through the front door.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Get onto the VCIA airfield and find an aircraft. [1]
Take off from the airfield — an unscheduled departure, not a booked flight. [6]
The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the airport. [2]

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — the trophy's joke title covers a tank encounter. Find a Rhino, get through the encounter, and the trophy is yours; heavy weapons and distance are the sensible approach.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Find a Rhino tank encounter in free roam. [1]
Deal with the tank — heavy weapons and keeping your distance help. [6]
The trophy pops when the encounter is resolved. [2]

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected once. This is a stealth job: go in quiet, avoid cameras and sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Pick a jewelry store and case it first — note the cameras and staff sightlines. [1]
Go in quiet and take the goods without being seen. [6]
Leave undetected; the trophy pops once you are clear. [2]

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies of the crime strand — plan each job, hit the vault, and get clear before the response closes in. Five clean escapes is the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Find a bank vault robbery and plan the approach and the escape route. [1]
Rob the vault, then escape clean — the robbery only counts if you get away. [5]
Repeat at 5 vaults; the silver pops after the fifth escape. [1]

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch the roads for a truck on its route, hit it, take the cash and get clear before the response arrives. One clean robbery and escape is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Find an armored truck on its route. [1]
Stop the truck and take the cash. [6]
Escape clean; the trophy pops once you are clear. [2]

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive and walk the whole state — every named area you enter counts. Sweep region by region in free roam and use the map here to see which areas are left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Travel into every named area of Leonida — the counter ticks up as new areas are entered. [1]
Track progress here (0/52) and sweep the regions you have not visited. [4]
The trophy pops when the 52nd area is explored. [2]

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations somewhere in Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and move on to the next gang's turf. Nine gangs, nine robberies.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Find an illegal operation on a gang's turf. [1]
Rob it, then move to the next gang's operation. [5]
The trophy pops once all 9 gangs have been hit. [2]

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — but the exact trigger has not been confirmed in public guides yet, so this entry will not invent one. What is known: the name suggests an early moment on Ocean Beach. Do it as early as you can, and check the source links here for any confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no confirmed unlock method is published. [1]
The description points to Ocean Beach, so visit it early and try the cocktail spot with the view. [2]
If it does not pop, leave it for cleanup and re-check the linked sources for a confirmed trigger. [6]

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The official description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — but the exact trigger has not been confirmed in public guides yet, so this entry will not invent one. A showroom, a vehicle, and a dramatic exit are the ingredients the description gives; the precise steps are still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no confirmed unlock method is published. [1]
The description points to a vehicle showroom exit, so try a showroom with a vehicle when you pass one. [2]
If it does not pop, leave it for cleanup and re-check the linked sources for a confirmed trigger. [6]

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. One of the activity types — find the alley, play a game of bowling through, and the trophy pops at the follow-through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. [1]
Play a game of bowling through to the end. [2]
The trophy pops at the follow-through, when the game ends. [3]

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the short official description gives no location or count, so read it as a moment shared with your partner. Try the game's shared partner activities together and watch for the pop; it sits in cleanup because there is nothing precise to schedule it around.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: The official description is short — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — with no location, count or activity named. [3]
Try shared activities with your partner in free roam, since the description points to a partnership moment. [1]
If it does not pop during the run, leave it for the cleanup phase and re-check the linked sources. [2]

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices. Choices stack up across missions, side content and free-roam decisions — this is a long cumulative counter, so do not chase it directly; it fills while you play everything else. The tracker counts it toward the grind phase.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Play missions and side content — choices are made in dialogue and mission decisions. [1]
Track the counter here (0/500); it is cumulative across the whole playthrough. [4]
The trophy pops at the 500th choice. [2]

trophies.guide: The official description — second time's the charm — hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed in public guides yet, so this entry will not invent one. Fail something, try it again, and succeed — that is the shape of it; the precise event is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no confirmed unlock method is published. [1]
The description suggests a second attempt that succeeds, so retry things you fail. [2]
If it does not pop, leave it for cleanup and re-check the linked sources for a confirmed trigger. [6]

trophies.guide: The official description — what the hell just happened? — points to witnessing something strange in Leonida, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed in public guides yet, so this entry will not invent one. Keep your eyes open for odd events while travelling the state.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no confirmed unlock method is published. [1]
The description suggests a strange event somewhere in Leonida — explore odd corners of the map. [2]
If it does not pop, leave it for cleanup and re-check the linked sources for a confirmed trigger. [6]

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — but the exact trigger has not been confirmed in public guides yet, so this entry will not invent the precise setup. The shape of it is in the description: a melee hit delivered from a moving vehicle. Try it in free roam and leave it for cleanup if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known — no confirmed unlock method is published. [1]
The description points to a melee drive-by — a melee hit from a moving vehicle. [2]
If it does not pop, leave it for cleanup and re-check the linked sources for a confirmed trigger. [6]

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them through contacts to clean them, and the clean money counts toward the $250,000. Rob, launder, repeat.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists. [1]
Launder them through your contacts — only cleaned money counts toward the total. [5]
The trophy pops when $250,000 has been laundered. [2]

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — weapons, clothes, food, vehicles — so this fills while you gear up for everything else. It pairs naturally with buying the garages.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Buy what you need across the shops — weapons, clothes and gear all count. [1]
Track spending here (0/$100,000) as you shop. [4]
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent. [2]

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought with clean money, so finish the laundering and spending first, then buy the garages one by one. Each purchase also counts toward the $100,000 shopping total.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Find the garage properties for sale across Leonida. [1]
Buy them one by one — the counter here tracks 0/8. [4]
The trophy pops when the eighth garage is purchased. [2]

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, register each one in the app, and repeat until ten are on the books. It pairs with discovering vehicles for the collection trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Find a vehicle and open the Scooter Bros app. [1]
Register the vehicle — the counter here tracks 0/10. [4]
The trophy pops when the tenth vehicle is registered. [2]
